info.title: Survive Platform
info.description: Digital life environments. Creator-owned environments, per-organism energy and running time, priced LLM inference, organism conversations, desktop snapshots, reports and grants. See /llm.txt for a complete example.

servers.description: Use the creator origin for /api routes and the sandbox environment origin for /env and /v1 model routes.
